---
title: Simple location data analysis in any generic RDV
output: html_document
params:
  df_rdv:
    label: "RDV"
    value: NA
  shp_path:
    label: "Shapefile path"
    value: NA
  shp_colname:
    label: "Name of column in shapefile to use"
    value: "LAD20NM"
  df_colname:
    label: "Name of column in RDV to use"
    value: "District"
  rank_colname:
    label: "Name of rank column in external index data"
    value: "imd_rank"
  decile_colname:
    label: "Name of decile column in external index data"
    value: "Index.of.Multiple.Deprivation..IMD..Decile"
  destination_long_lat:
    label: "Longitude and latitude of destination point"
    value: NA
  stratify_by:
    label: "stratify_by"
    value: "cohort"
  distance:
    label: "distribution of distance or time to destination"
    value: "travel_km"
  group_cols:
    label: "Grouping columns"
    value: "County"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r results, echo = FALSE}

gla_result <- NULL

if (!is.null(params$df_rdv)) {

  if (any(params$destination_long_lat == 'NA')) {
    destination_long_lat <- c(-0.120299, 51.522388)
  } else {
    destination_long_lat <- params$destination_long_lat
  }
  gla_result <- driveanalytics::gen_location_analysis(
    params$df_rdv,
    params$shp_path,
    params$shp_colname,
    params$df_colname,
    params$rank_colname,
    params$decile_colname,
    destination_long_lat,
    params$stratify_by,
    params$distance,
    params$group_cols
  )

}

```

# Home locations

```{r maps, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='asis', fig.align='center'}

if (!is.null(gla_result$list_maps)) {
  for (i in 1:length(gla_result$list_maps)) {
    filename <- paste0(gla_result$list_maps[[i]]$group, "map.png")
    mapview::mapshot(gla_result$list_maps[[i]]$map, file = filename)
    cat(gla_result$list_maps[[i]]$group, " \n")
    cat(paste0("![](", filename, "){width=70%}"), " \n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No location data\n")
}

if (!is.null(gla_result$distance_density) && !is.null(gla_result$distance_boxplot)) {
  gla_result$distance_density
  gla_result$distance_boxplot
} else {
  cat("\nNo travel distance data")
}

```

# Analysis of Index of Multiple Deprivation

```{r index_plots, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='asis'}

if (!is.null(gla_result$imd_bar_plot) && !is.null(gla_result$imd_violin_plot)) {
  gla_result$imd_bar_plot
  gla_result$imd_violin_plot
} else {
  cat("No IMD data")
}

```
